# FraudLens AI

> Paste a suspicious SMS, WhatsApp, or email message and get a structured
> breakdown of scam warning signs (sender mismatch, urgency language,
> lookalike links, spoofed identity) plus a suggested next action. Built for
> Mauritius: works in English, French, and Kreol Morisien, including
> messages that mix all three.

- [Check a message](/): paste text or upload a screenshot for analysis.
- [Learn the warning signs](/learn): the signal types FraudLens checks for.
- [Known scam patterns](/trends): common Mauritius-specific scam formats.
